note: Sonic's resources on the SADX disc (read once at startup by Loading::loadPlayerKeys; a missing or wrong file stops the game). Everything but the animation names is a disc offset: model roots and motions of ModelsMiles.rel (external, SA Tools GameConfig/GC_SADX/ModelsMiles.ini, section [Sonic] and the motion names in quotes) and the texture archive. The animation names ('walk', 'jumpC' ...) are ours, the names the Lua scripts use.

body.note: Sonic's root NJS_OBJECT (external, SA Tools ModelsMiles.ini, [Sonic]).

curled.note: The jump's model (external: the table at _Main.rel 0x3544E0 pairs each animation id with a model and a motion; id 0xE, 'Spring Launch').

jumpball.note: The spin ball's model (external: same table, id 0x20, 'Spin (Jumpball)').

idle.note: 'Sonic Alternate Stand', 73 nodes (external, SA Tools ModelsMiles.ini; observed: 16 frames, position and rotation keys, linear). Played when Sonic is made.

animationsNote: The motions of ModelsMiles.rel, 73 nodes like his body model (external, SA Tools ModelsMiles.ini). Which one the game plays for which speed and move is the table at _Main.rel 0x3544E0 (16 bytes per animation id, a pointer to the motion first; external, Ghidra pseudocode of sadxDecomp): id 0 Stand, 9 Walk, 10 Speedwalk, 11 Jog, 12 Run, 13 Sprint, 0x12 Fall, 0x13 Landing, 0x11 Begin Falling From Spring Launch, 0x14 Brake, 0x17 Damage, 0x1E Turn Around. 'Spring Launch' (0xE, 74 nodes) is the jump, with the curled model; the spin ball (id 0x20, 'Spin (Jumpball)', 1 node) has the jumpball model. Which motion plays in which state is chosen by the scripts (hypothesis, from the names).
